description: Non-English, in-domain customer support queries used ONLY to tune the guardrail embedding model. These must reach the model, never a rail: a Spanish-speaking customer asking about a refund is an ordinary support request. Written to be disjoint in wording from the three non_english_mixed probes in ood_queries.jsonl, which remain held out.
